what_happened.line: The commission voted unanimously to authorize the recreation director to contract for three to five portable toilets at the beach, preferring the far end with a gate.
The chair is to speak with the conservation agent before the recreation director proceeds with placing the beach toilets.
Consultants presented the final Marshall Park design and cost estimate; a detailed line-item estimate will go to the chair and on to the town manager to decide next steps.
The commission authorized the skate park group to post a sign near the Marshall Park entrance, once it is checked against town bylaws.
A vote on two returning lifeguards was recorded as not audible, and approval of prior minutes was held until names are corrected.

why_it_matters: The Marshall Park estimate is what the town manager will weigh when deciding whether and how to fund the park, so it bears on a future capital request residents may be asked to vote on.
Beach toilets, a gate and safety barriers set what the beach costs to run and how it is used this season, and the quotes for each were reported but not totalled in the minutes.
